capabilities: Show file content previews under file titles in the file explorer
Toggle previews on and off with a button at the top of the file explorer
Refresh previews for newly created files via a ribbon button
extras: Previews are only generated for files that already exist; new files require clicking the refresh button on the left ribbon.
intentEvidence: Add file preview contents under markdown file's title in file explorer.
problem: The file explorer shows only file names, so you must open a file to see what it contains.
summary: Shows a preview of each Markdown file's contents under its title in the file explorer.
